svg.title: The eye: accommodation and corrective lenses
svg.desc: Schematic eye diagram identifies sclera, ciliary muscle, suspensory ligaments and lens for near and distant accommodation, and shows concave correction of myopia and convex correction of hyperopia.
svg.text: The eye: accommodation and corrective lenses
Marlbridge • AQA GCSE Biology 8461 • Homeostasis and response (4.5.2.3)
CORRECTIVE LENSES • REFRACT TO THE RETINA
Focus falls in front of the retina.
Focus would fall behind the retina.
Myopia: distant focus in front → concave (diverging) lens. Hyperopia: near focus behind → convex (converging) lens. Schematic rays, not to scale.
